name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Loans up to 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun).
benefits: Collateral-free business loan from ₹50,000 up to ₹10 Lakhs

criteria.description: Age must be at least 18 years
Applicant must be setting up or running non-corporate small enterprise
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant occupation is not eligible for Mudra loans
